name.es: Índice de presión de la vivienda turística

notes: Weights and severities are index-design choices, not probabilities of illegality. Change them only with a new version. 1.1 (19 Oct 2026): cohort = every municipality over 300,000 inhabitants (13), replacing the hand-picked ten largest plus Alicante. 1.2 (19 Oct 2026): where adverts needn't show the number (Madrid), adverts without one are left out of the registration score (numerator and denominator). 1.3 (19 Oct 2026): concentration circle 500 m radius (1 km across, about 0.8 km²), was 1 km radius; hotspot named after the barrio with most of its listings, else the postcode of most registered flats. 2.0 (21 Oct 2026): no final rescaling: the index is the weighted sum of the three normalised factors (out of 100); the leading city no longer scores 100 by construction. Scores from 1.x are on a different scale.

cohort.source: INE, Cifras oficiales de población de los municipios españoles a 1 de enero de 2025 (Real Decreto 1117/2025, BOE-A-2025-25362; INE table 29005)
cohort.review: Once a year, when the next Real Decreto of official population figures is published (usually December). Nearest below the threshold: Vigo 294,489; L'Hospitalet de Llobregat 289,510.
